d: National Conference president and former Jammu and Kashmir Chief Minister Farooq Abdullah asserted that terrorism will never succeed and affirmed, 'Kashmir Hindustan ka hissa tha, hai aur rahega.' Pointing to recent attacks in Kishtwar, he countered claims from New Delhi that terrorism had ended, stressing that solutions must be found through dialogue rather than warfare. Urging Pakistan to end cross-border terrorism and pursue talks, he advocated reviving SAARC for regional peace and cooperation. He also dismissed questions on Sonia Gandhi's book, noting he had not read it.
